description: This file declares the interface for the IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory class, which is a factory class responsible for creating instances of ServerManagerModule and the factory itself within the Rialto server IPC component.

classes.name: IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create instances of ServerManagerModule and the factory itself.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a ServerManagerModule object, given a reference to an ISessionServerManager.
